course.title: Unit 3 Could you please clean your room?【例句】

sentences.content: The Sunday Mail magazine invited parents to write about whether they think young people should do chores at home.
sentences.english: The Sunday Mail magazine invited parents to write about whether they think young people should do chores at home
sentences.chinese: 《星期日邮报》杂志邀请家长们就年轻人是否应该在家做家务发表看法。

sentences.content: Dear Sir, I do not understand why some parents make their kids help with housework and chores at home.
sentences.english: Dear Sir , I do not understand why some parents make their kids help with housework and chores at home
sentences.chinese: 尊敬的先生，我不明白为什么有些父母要让孩子帮忙做家务和家里的杂活。

sentences.content: Kids these days already have enough stress from school.
sentences.english: Kids these days already have enough stress from school
sentences.chinese: 现在的孩子们已经承受了足够的学业压力。

sentences.content: They do not have time to study and do housework, too.
sentences.english: They do not have time to study and do housework , too
sentences.chinese: 他们既没有时间学习，也没时间做家务。

sentences.content: Housework is a waste of their time.
sentences.english: Housework is a waste of their time
sentences.chinese: 家务活是在浪费他们的时间。

sentences.content: Could we just let them do their job as students?
sentences.english: Could we just let them do their job as students ?
sentences.chinese: 我们能不能就让他们安心做好学生的本分？

sentences.content: They should spend their time on schoolwork in order to get good grades and get into a good university.
sentences.english: They should spend their time on schoolwork in order to get good grades and get into a good university
sentences.chinese: 他们应该把时间花在学业上，这样才能取得好成绩并进入一所好大学。

sentences.content: Also, when they get older, they will have to do housework so there is no need for them to do it now.
sentences.english: Also , when they get older , they will have to do housework so there is no need for them to do it now
sentences.chinese: 况且，等他们长大了自然要做家务，现在没必要让他们做。

sentences.content: It is the parents’ job to provide a clean and comfortable environment at home for their children.
sentences.english: It is the parents' job to provide a clean and comfortable environment at home for their children
sentences.chinese: 为子女提供干净舒适的家庭环境是父母的责任。

sentences.content: And anyway, I think doing chores is not so difficult.
sentences.english: And anyway , I think doing chores is not so difficult
sentences.chinese: 而且，我觉得做家务也没那么难。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

sentences.content: I do not mind doing them.
sentences.english: I do not mind doing them
sentences.chinese: 我不介意做这些事。

sentences.content: Ms. Miller
sentences.english: Ms . Miller
sentences.chinese: Miller女士

sentences.content: Dear Sir, I think it is important for children to learn how to do chores and help their parents with housework.
sentences.english: Dear Sir , I think it is important for children to learn how to do chores and help their parents with housework
sentences.chinese: 尊敬的先生，我认为让孩子学习如何做家务并帮助父母分担家务是很重要的。

sentences.content: It is not enough to just get good grades at school.
sentences.english: It is not enough to just get good grades at school
sentences.chinese: 仅仅在学校取得好成绩是不够的。

sentences.content: Children these days depend on their parents too much.
sentences.english: Children these days depend on their parents too much
sentences.chinese: 现在的孩子太过依赖父母了。

sentences.content: They are always asking, “Could you get this for me?” or “Could you help me with that?”
sentences.english: They are always asking ," Could you get this for me ?" or " Could you help me with that ?"
sentences.chinese: 他们总是问：“你能帮我拿这个吗？”或者“你能帮我做那个吗？”

wordDetails.definition: are（现在时）: 构成现在进行时

sentences.content: Doing chores helps to develop children’s independence and teaches them how to look after themselves.
sentences.english: Doing chores helps to develop children's independence and teaches them how to look after themselves
sentences.chinese: 做家务有助于培养孩子的独立性，并教会他们如何照顾自己。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数）: 帮助

sentences.content: It also helps them to understand the idea of fairness.
sentences.english: It also helps them to understand the idea of fairness
sentences.chinese: 这也有助于他们理解公平的概念。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数）: 帮助

sentences.content: Since they live in one house with their parents, they should know that everyone should do their part in keeping it clean and tidy.
sentences.english: Since they live in one house with their parents , they should know that everyone should do their part in keeping it clean and tidy
sentences.chinese: 既然他们与父母同住在一个屋檐下，就应该明白每个人都有责任保持房屋的整洁。

sentences.content: Our neighbors’ son got into a good college but during his first year, he had no idea how to take care of himself.
sentences.english: Our neighbors' son got into a good college but during his first year , he had no idea how to take care of himself
sentences.chinese: 我们邻居的儿子考上了一所好大学，但在大一那年，他完全不懂得如何照顾自己。

sentences.content: As a result, he often fell ill and his grades dropped.
sentences.english: As a result , he often fell ill and his grades dropped
sentences.chinese: 因此，他经常生病，成绩也下降了。

sentences.content: The earlier kids learn to be independent, the better it is for their future.
sentences.english: The earlier kids learn to be independent , the better it is for their future
sentences.chinese: 孩子越早学会独立，对他们的未来就越有利。

sentences.content: Mr. Smith
sentences.english: Mr. Smith
sentences.chinese: Smith先生

sentences.content: Parent: Could you clean your room?
sentences.english: Parent : Could you clean your room ?
sentences.chinese: 家长：你能打扫一下你的房间吗？

sentences.content: Child: Yes, I can.
sentences.english: Child : Yes , I can
sentences.chinese: 孩子：是的，我能。

sentences.content: Child: Could I invite my friends to a party?
sentences.english: Child : Could I invite my friends to a party ?
sentences.chinese: 孩子：我能邀请朋友们来参加派对吗？

sentences.content: Parent: No, you can’t have a party. You have a test on Monday.
sentences.english: Parent : No , you can't have a party . You have a test on Monday
sentences.chinese: 家长：不行，你不能办派对。周一你还有考试呢。

sentences.content: A: Could you please take out the rubbish?
sentences.english: A : Could you please take out the rubbish ?
sentences.chinese: A：你能把垃圾拿出去吗？

sentences.content: B: Yes, sure.
sentences.english: B : Yes , sure
sentences.chinese: B: 是的，当然。
